description: This file defines the main React component 'Board' for a Tic Tac Toe game UI, managing game state, rendering the game grid, handling user interactions, and providing reset functionality.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: React functional component that renders the game board, manages game state (board array, current player), handles user moves, determines game over conditions, and provides a reset option.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a square; updates the board and current player if the move is valid and game not over.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.
